title: "About Me"

I am a business analytics professional with more than three years of experience in manufacturing operations, quality management, data analysis, and cross-functional project support.

I am currently pursuing a **Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University**, where I continue to strengthen my skills in data analytics, machine learning, big data, and business decision-making.

Before beginning my graduate studies, I worked as a **Quality Analyst at DMC Power, a Hubbell Incorporated company**, where I used operational, supplier, testing, and ERP data to support management decisions and process improvements.

My professional experience includes:

- Analyzing operational and quality data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
- Developing Power BI dashboards and management reports
- Performing cost, ROI, and investment analyses
- Supporting ISO 9001 quality management activities
- Coordinating projects across engineering, manufacturing, purchasing, suppliers, and management
- Using ERP and business data to support investigations and decision-making

## Career Goals

My goal is to build a career at the intersection of **data analytics, business strategy, and operations**.
